notes: 'nevermore' is one indivisible word carrying the existential negation and the עַד־עוֹלָם of perpetuity, so the three morphemes share one unit (rules 30, 35), with the existential frame joining it and the head on the negation (rule 50). The competing reading marks עַד and עוֹלָם unrepresented beside a lone אַיִן; the corpus heads such a fused 'never' both ways.
The suffix on the existential takes the referential subject pronoun 'thou' (rule 50).
